Add LRCX as a direct etch/deposition/clean and advanced-packaging process-tool candidate; verify HBM and packaging revenue mix in later layers.

Add TER as a direct automated-test-equipment candidate for AI compute, networking, HBM, and DRAM test bottlenecks.
The node should be tracked as an equipment cluster: lithography, deposition, etch, process control, inspection/metrology, advanced packaging, bonding, and test rather than EUV alone.

node: Semiconductor equipment for leading-edge logic, memory, advanced packaging, and test
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the semiconductor equipment/process-tools chokepoint beyond AI chip designers and foundries. The most relevant direct exposures are diversified wafer-fab equipment, etch/deposition, process-control/metrology/inspection, advanced-packaging process control, and automated test equipment. The evidence supports a cluster bottleneck rather than a single EUV-only bottleneck: SEMI forecasts record equipment sales driven by advanced logic, memory/HBM, and advanced packaging; company filings and releases show AI/HBM/advanced packaging as explicit demand drivers for AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, ONTO, and TER. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell ranking.
